in_marathi.name: Kuviraaj
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Universe
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kuviraaj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Kuviraaj is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Kuvi', which means 'Lord of the Universe'. In Hindu mythology, Kuviraaj is often depicted as a powerful and wise king, who rules over the cosmos. He is known for his strength, courage, and wisdom, and is revered as a protector and a symbol of divine justice.
